name: What maintenance is required for new hardwood floors?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for new hardwood floors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining new hardwood floors involves regular cleaning and protective measures. Sweep or vacuum regularly to remove dirt and grit that can scratch the finish. Use a wood-specific cleaner with a damp (not wet) mop for deeper cleaning. Avoid harsh chemicals, abrasive cleaners, and excessive water. Place protective pads under furniture legs and use area rugs in high-traffic zones to prevent wear. Promptly clean up spills to prevent water damage. Proper care ensures the longevity and beauty of your floors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regularly sweep or vacuum floors and use a wood-specific cleaner with a damp mop. Avoid harsh chemicals and excessive water. Use protective pads under furniture and promptly clean spills to maintain floor quality.
